pages.title: kute — the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.description: kute makes a cluster's actual state visible without digging — triage-first sorting, live failure states that never go blank, and guardrails that scale with blast radius. Try it in one command, no cluster needed.
pages.ogTitle: kute — the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.ogDescription: Your cluster, in plain sight. Modern Kubernetes TUI. Try kute --demo — no cluster needed.
pages.twitterDescription: Your cluster, in plain sight. Modern Kubernetes TUI.

pages.title: Features — kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.description: Every screen kute ships, explained: cluster overview as a routing layer not a dashboard, pod detail that leads with the last termination, secret decode that never touches disk, and Ingress/Gateway API routing tables resolved live.
pages.ogTitle: Features — kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.ogDescription: Every screen kute ships, explained — one skeleton, forty screens.
pages.twitterDescription: Every screen kute ships, explained — one skeleton, forty screens.

pages.title: Demo — kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.description: Watch kute in motion: an incident walkthrough from a clean namespace to a correlated rollout, the namespace and goto palettes' alt-tab gestures, everyday Deployment actions, and the Ingress/Gateway API routing table resolving a broken backend live — all recorded straight from kute --demo.

pages.ogDescription: Watch kute in motion — recorded straight from kute --demo, no cluster needed.
pages.twitterDescription: Watch kute in motion — recorded straight from kute --demo, no cluster needed.

pages.title: Verify a release — kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.description: Every kute release archive is signed with a keyless cosign identity bound to the release workflow, ships an SBOM, and carries a GitHub build provenance attestation. Here is how to check all three by hand.
pages.ogTitle: Verify a release — kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.ogDescription: Signed, attested, and checkable in one command — how to verify a kute download is really ours.
pages.twitterDescription: Signed, attested, and checkable in one command — how to verify a kute download is really ours.
